name: Pink Elephants 2 - Reborn
review:
Pink Elephants 2 - Reborn is a 6-reel slot with 4,096 connecting ways. A mystery scatter unlocks a bonus with free spins, symbol transformations and retriggers, and there's a feature buy.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap and a 96.13% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
